info.title: Batch product price update
info.description: Supplemental API referenced by the official POP solution but absent from the current category catalog; availability and app permission are unverified.

items.description: The product list, in which the price needs to be updated. Maximum length:20
The sku list, in which the inventory needs to be updated within the same product id

discount_price.description: discount_price of an sku. If not set, the discount_price will be erased.

items.description: Sku price list under the same ship_to_country

price.description: Value of price configuration. If the price of a specific country is set, it must be greater than or equal to 70% of the original sku price in multiple_sku_update_list

discount_price.description: Value of discount_price for each country

ship_to_country.description: Currently supporting RU US CA ES FR UK NL IL BR CL AU UA BY JP TH SG KR ID MY PH VN IT DE SA AE PL TR

price_type.description: Currently supporting only absolute. Please test carefully before uploading products.

update_error_code.description: When success equals false, indicating the error code

update_error_message.description: When success equals false, indicating the error message

update_success.description: Indicates the update result is successful or not. Only all the products in mutiple_product_update_list have been updated successfully will make the success to be true, otherwise false.
